info.title: Velora DNS Management API
info.description: Session cookies require X-CSRF-Token on mutations. API bearer tokens bypass CSRF and require the documented scope. All API responses use a data or error envelope except text/dns zone export. Secrets are never returned by read endpoints.

bearerAuth.description: velora_ API token; scopes read, write, or admin

update_interval.description: Scheduled refresh period in seconds: 0 (manual) or 3600-604800; URL sources only

next_update_at.description: Derived; null when the source is manual, local or disabled

update_interval.description: Scheduled refresh period in seconds: 0 (manual) or 3600-604800; URL sources only

client_name.description: Friendly name of the matching client definition, when any

name.description: Client name for top_clients entries, when known

average_ms.description: Average upstream response time of answered queries

domain.description: Domain suffix; the rule also covers every name below it

blocked_by.description: blocklist when filtering answers the name first

overrides_zone.description: Local zone whose answers this rewrite replaces

name.description: Host name, or *.parent for every name below parent

value.description: IPv4, IPv6 or target host name

blocklists.description: Blocklist source IDs used in custom mode; they apply even when disabled globally

allow.description: Domains (and their subdomains) never blocked for this client

block.description: Extra domains (and their subdomains) blocked for this client

events.description: Subscribed event types; empty means all

has_token.description: Whether a bearer token is stored; the token itself is never returned

url.description: http:// or https:// URL without credentials

allow_private.description: Allow private and loopback destinations; link-local and metadata addresses are always rejected

token.description: Write-only bearer token. On update, omit or null to keep the stored token, empty string to remove it

activity.description: Last 24 hours of retained queries; null when query logging is disabled
